items.titleZh: 安德森为F1阻挡问题提供简单解决方案
items.summaryZh: F1赛事中，车手在快圈时被阻挡的问题不断，安德森提出通过增大后视镜尺寸来解决这个问题。
items.originalTitle: Gary Anderson's simple solution for F1's impeding problem
detailZh: 在每一个一级方程式赛车周末，都有关于车手在快速圈中被阻挡的持续抱怨。当今天的美国大奖赛资格赛发生时，我们可以期待更多这样的抱怨。
然而，有一个简单的解决方案可以立即实施，以防止这些几乎发生的碰撞。
问题的严重性是显而易见的。今年已经有12个赛周末中的17个赛周末进行了 裁判长，此处指赛事裁判对阻碍行为的调查，总共发出了14项处罚，其中包括一些发车线处罚。即使没有达到这个程度，无线电波中充满了车手们通过无线电抱怨被阻挡的情况。
这不需要一个复杂的解决方案，也不需要重新发明轮子或花费巨额资金。甚至不需要添加任何新东西。
简单地将规则修改为将后视镜的尺寸加倍，并更精确地定义这些镜子的理想位置。
这里的‘理想’并不是指空气动力学上的理想——我的意思是对于车手的视线来说。
为了让大家有个概念，我在右边的图片上用白色标出了我会如何操作奔驰车。你可以看到左边与红牛当前标准尺寸后视镜的对比。
是的，这将会增加一点阻力，使得空气动力学设计更加困难，但更重要的是减少由于视线受阻而改变排位次数的情况。
然后重点可以放在车手对自己的行为负责上。镜子的位置将被指定——为了确保没有人试图利用任何灰色地带或漏洞，可以有一个补充测试，要求车手能够坐在驾驶舱内阅读放置在车辆指定位置后的板上。所以就像视力测试，但是反过来的。
我们经常听说车手的后视镜会振动。当然，这个问题不应该超出F1及其设计团队的能力范围。如果真的超出了，那么外面有无数的振动专家会非常乐意提供解决方案。
如果一个车队进入了一辆仍然存在后视镜振动问题的赛车，那么这属于'危险构造'。如果车手看不到他们后面的车辆，那么他们必须承担车队让他们陷入的情况的后果。
有时，由于维修区的信息不准确，车手会受到减刑甚至完全取消处罚。是的，拥有这些信息是有帮助的，而且应该继续这样做——但是遵守的责任应该落在车手身上。
通过给车手提供更好的视野，这将使他们没有借口不集中注意力。
detailEn: Every Formula 1 race weekend, there are constant complaints about drivers being blocked when on a fast lap. Expect more when United States Grand Prix qualifying happens later today.
Yet there is a simple solution that could be implemented immediately to prevent these near-misses.

The extent of the problem is obvious. There have been stewards’ investigations into impeding on 12 out of 17 race weekends already this year, with a total of 14 punishments issued, some of those grid penalties. And even when it doesn’t go this far, the airwaves are filled with drivers complaining about being held up over the radio.
This doesn’t need a complicated fix that requires you to reinvent the wheel or spend huge amounts of money. It doesn’t even need something new to be added.
Simply change the regulations to double the size of the rear-view mirrors and more closely define the ideal position for those.
By 'ideal' I don’t mean aerodynamically ideal - I mean for the driver’s line of sight.

To give an idea of the size, I’ve highlighted what I would do in white on the Mercedes in the image on the right. You can see the comparison to the current standard size mirrors on the Red Bull on the left.
Yes, it will create a little more drag and make the aero design more difficult, but it’s more important to reduce the number of times qualifying is changed by impeding.

Then the emphasis can be on the driver to be responsible for their actions. The mirror position will be specified - and to ensure that nobody attempts to exploit any grey areas or loopholes, you can have a supplementary test that requires a driver to be able to sit in the cockpit and read something on a board placed in specified positions behind the car. So like an eye test, but backwards.

We often hear about the drivers’ rear-view mirrors vibrating. Surely this problem is not beyond the might of F1 and its design teams to solve. And if it is, there are numerous vibration specialists out there that would be only too happy to come up with a solution.

If a team enters a car that still suffers mirror vibration problems, then that comes under 'dangerous construction'. If the driver can’t see a car behind them, then they have to suffer the consequences of the situation that the team has put them into.

There are occasions when the drivers have had penalties reduced or sometimes even dropped entirely because of poor information from the pitwall. Yes, it is helpful to have this information and it should continue - but the onus to comply should be on the driver.
By giving the drivers better visibility, it would give them no excuses for not paying attention.
keyPointsZh: 安德森建议通过增大后视镜尺寸来减少阻挡
新规将使车手对自身行为负责
keyPointsEn: Anderson suggests solving the issue by increasing the size of rear-view mirrors
The new regulation will make drivers responsible for their actions

items.titleZh: 哈贾尔奥斯汀练习赛挣扎：赛车完全无法驾驶
items.summaryZh: 红牛车手哈贾尔在奥斯汀练习赛后表示赛车“完全无法驾驶”，他在第一节练习赛后调整了调校方向，但结果适得其反。

media.altZh: 哈贾尔奥斯汀练习赛挣扎：赛车完全无法驾驶 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: "Just undriveable" – Isack Hadjar looking for answers after "massive" struggles in Austin practice
items.summaryEn: Red Bull driver Isack Hadjar said his car was "just undriveable" after practice in Austin, having changed his set-up direction after FP1 only to go the wrong way.
detailZh: “完全无法驾驶”——伊萨克·哈贾尔在奥斯汀练习赛中遭遇“巨大”困难后寻找答案
维斯塔潘谈到在奥斯汀的开局总体积极，而哈贾尔则得出结论：他在调校上走错了方向。他的前轮胎在第一个计时段结束后就已经耗尽。
在美洲赛道的F1练习赛中，红牛经历了喜忧参半的一天。马克斯·维斯塔潘对小红牛22的早期迹象基本满意，但他强调高速弯与低速弯之间的平衡仍需改进，技术总监皮埃尔·瓦什表示红牛需要在赛道较慢的路段取得提升。
维斯塔潘用了“微调”这个词，但车库另一侧显然还远未到那个阶段。伊萨克·哈贾尔在第一节练习赛中整体感觉积极，尽管最终排名第14，但他决定在当天第二节练习赛中尝试略有不同的调校方向。
“我（在第一节练习赛后）确实做了很多调整。今天早上我对进展还算满意。之后，我以为自己正朝着正确的方向前进，但这只带来了更多问题，”这位法国人总结道。
“即使我们改动了赛车，我在中性胎上感觉还可以。但在软胎上，赛车对我来说完全失控了。驾驶非常困难，所以我明天需要扭转局面。
“我们需要坐下来看看能做些什么，因为赛车性能大幅下降。我们需要把它恢复过来，至少恢复到今天早上的水平。”
在第二节练习赛期间，哈贾尔已经在车队无线电中表达了他的不满。尤其是他的排位赛模拟完全崩溃，使他在当天结束时落后队友维斯塔潘将近整整一秒。
平衡问题导致哈贾尔的前轮极快过热，随之而来的是所有相应后果。
“简直就是一场灾难。我的大部分圈速是在第一赛段做出的，但从第一赛段到圈尾，我比用中性胎时还要慢。赛车根本没法开，我严重失去前部抓地力。
“我们需要查看一下，因为这很不正常，为什么一圈之内会有这么大的性能衰退。前轮在高速弯里完全被毁掉了。”
据瓦赫所说，这种情况尤其出现在S弯（Esses）路段，之后哈贾尔不得不在该圈的剩余部分付出代价。
红牛车队的技术总监表示：“在这种赛道布局下，1号弯之后的第一赛段全是高速弯。我认为如果你在那里把轮胎用得过热，这一圈基本上就废了。”
为了排位赛，情况自然需要大幅改善，尽管哈贾尔从维斯塔潘当天的表现中获得了一些信心。哈贾尔仍然抱有希望，认为他能在排位赛开始、封闭车检条件生效之前，通过新的调校改动扭转局面。
“是的，我的意思是，如果他们能在另一侧做到的话……轮胎温度简直高得离谱，但我们在那些弯道里跑的速度是一样的。所以我们需要在赛车平衡上调整一些东西。我们尝试了不同的设置，但感觉这么糟糕，说实话我有点意外。”
detailEn: "Just undriveable" – Isack Hadjar looking for answers after "massive" struggles in Austin practice
While Verstappen spoke of a largely positive start in Austin, Hadjar concluded that he had gone in the wrong direction with his set-up. His front tyres were already finished after the first sector

It was a day of contrasting fortunes for Red Bull during Formula 1 practice at the Circuit of the Americas. Max Verstappen was largely satisfied with the early signs of the RB22, although he stressed that the balance between high-speed and low-speed corners still needed improvement, with technical director Pierre Wache indicating that Red Bull needed to make gains in the slower sections of the track.

Verstappen used the word 'fine-tuning', but things are certainly not at that stage on the other side of the garage. Isack Hadjar had a largely positive feeling during FP1, despite finishing 14th in the standings, but decided to explore a slightly different set-up direction for the second session of the day.

"I did [make a lot of changes after FP1]. I was happy-ish with how it went this morning. Afterwards, I thought I was heading in the right direction, but it only brought a lot more problems", the Frenchman concluded.
"I still felt okay on the medium, even though we changed the car. But on the soft, the car was completely gone for me. It was very difficult to drive, so I need to turn things around tomorrow.
"We need to sit down and see what we can do because the car made a massive step down. We need to bring it back, at least to the level it was this morning."

Hadjar had already been voicing his frustrations over the team radio during FP2. His qualifying simulation in particular fell apart, leaving him almost a full second behind team-mate Verstappen at the end of the day.
The balance problems caused Hadjar's front tyres to overheat extremely quickly, with all the consequences that entailed.

"It was just a disaster. I made most of my lap time in sector 1, but from sector 1 until the end of the lap I was slower than on the medium. It was just undriveable, I was losing the front end massively.
"We need to have a look because this is not normal, why there was so much degradation over one lap. The fronts were completely killed in the high-speed [corners]."
This happened particularly through the Esses, after which Hadjar had to pay the price for the remainder of the lap, according to Wache.

"With this type of lay-out, you have the full high-speed corners in sector 1, after Turn 1. And I think if you overcook the tyres there, it's more or less finished for the lap", Red Bull’s technical director said.

Things naturally need to improve significantly for qualifying, although Hadjar took some confidence from Verstappen's day. Hadjar remains hopeful that he can turn the situation around with fresh set-up changes before parc ferme conditions come into effect at the start of qualifying.

"Yes, I mean, if they manage to do it on the other side… The [tyre] temperatures are just sky-high, but we are running at the same speeds in those corners. So we need to tweak something on the car balance. We were running different things to try, but to have such a bad feeling, I’m a bit surprised to be honest."
keyPointsZh: 哈贾尔在第一节练习赛中排名第14，但整体感觉尚可，随后决定尝试略有不同的调校方向
哈贾尔表示他的前轮胎在第一个计时段结束后就已经耗尽
维斯塔潘对小红牛22的初步迹象基本满意，但强调高速弯与低速弯之间的平衡仍需改进
keyPointsEn: Hadjar finished FP1 in 14th but had a largely positive feeling and then decided to explore a slightly different set-up direction for FP2

items.titleZh: 本田第二次动力单元升级后仍受涡轮迟滞困扰
items.summaryZh: 本田在马德里使用第二次ADUO升级后仍受涡轮迟滞困扰，能量回收较多的赛道上驾驶性低于预期。阿隆索在新加坡赛后指出本田动力单元存在驾驶性问题。

media.altZh: 本田第二次动力单元升级后仍受涡轮迟滞困扰 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: The unexpected problem Honda encountered despite its second F1 power unit upgrade
items.summaryEn: Honda is still struggling with turbo lag after using its second ADUO upgrade in Madrid, with driveability on energy-rich circuits falling below expectations. After the Singapore race, Fernando Alonso pointed to driveability problems with the Honda power unit.
detailZh: 本田第二次动力单元升级后仍遇意外问题
即便已在马德里用上第二次ADUO升级，这家日本制造商仍在与涡轮迟滞作斗争。因此在能量回收较多的赛道上，驾驶性低于预期
在马来西亚经历了一个意外成功的F1比赛周末后，阿斯顿·马丁对新加坡的期望也很高，这条赛道纸面上本应适合AMR26。
然而滨海湾街道赛道的竞争力表现相当令人失望，费尔南多·阿隆索在赛后指出本田动力单元存在问题，尤其是在驾驶性方面。
本田随后将其工程师和动力单元都送回樱市进行更深入的调查。这些检查并未发现任何具体的硬件故障。相反，结果显示这家日本制造商主要是在与涡轮迟滞作斗争——即涡轮增压器加速所需的时间，也就是踩下油门与感受到涡轮介入效果之间的延迟。
这本身并不是一个新问题。事实上，它是赞德沃特引入的新动力单元规格影响驾驶性的因素之一。但正因如此，本田在马德里使用了其今年第二个额外研发升级机会配额，引入了一款旨在消除该问题的新涡轮增压器。
然而，在接受Motorsport.com采访时，本田首席赛道工程师折原慎太郎透露，这个问题在新加坡出人意料地再次成为问题。
“尽管我们引入了新的涡轮增压器来管理涡轮迟滞，但由于独特的赛道布局以及能量充沛的情况，我们在新加坡仍然难以管理这种迟滞。这给车手带来了一些不稳定的加速，”折原承认道。
本田赛车公司赛道现场总经理兼首席工程师折原慎太郎
当被问及是否可以通过在不同于通常位置部署MGU-K来部分补偿涡轮迟滞时，折原解释说，这只能在一定程度上起作用，尽管他强调MGU-K以另一种方式加剧了这个问题。
他说：“MGU-K的部署可以帮助[对抗]涡轮迟滞，但不足以补偿它。如果我们去能量丰富的赛道，我们通常利用MGU-K的能量回收来补偿涡轮迟滞。如果我们有足够的MGU-K回收功率，那么发动机可以在收油路段以高工作点运行。”
“这有助于改善涡轮迟滞，这很好，但如果我们去能量丰富的赛道，有时由于能量丰富的情况，很难获得足够的MGU-K回收值。在这种情况下，发动机的运行模式不足以控制涡轮迟滞，这就是我们在新加坡挣扎的原因。”
本田在樱工厂检查期间未发现具体问题，这一事实可能引发担忧。毕竟，这表明当阿斯顿·马丁重返能量密集型赛道时，同样的问题可能再次出现。
然而，本田强调已吸取教训，并采取了新措施——不是在硬件方面，而是在本田通过软件和设置操作动力单元的方式上。
“是的，我们从新加坡学到了一些东西，因此我们正在为未来准备对策，”折原表示。“我们明白需要改进对涡轮迟滞的控制。目前，我们的控制未能满足车手需求，所以我们采取了一些对策。但同样，我们需要检查这些对策在动力单元上的效果。”
阿斯顿·马丁在新加坡学到的心理教训
至于新加坡站，阿斯顿·马丁首席赛道官迈克·克拉克表示，失望情绪因进入比赛周末时期望过高而进一步加剧。这也是阿斯顿·马丁已经吸取教训、并将在奥斯汀力求避免重演的问题。
当被Motorsport.com问及这种失望时，克拉克说：“我一直把它们称为情绪动态。我认为雪邦站的结果可能让我们感到意外，并且把（对新加坡站的）期望值抬高了，甚至可能超出了现实水平。
“而当由于各种原因未能兑现时，每个人都会感到失望，整个周末也会变得更加艰难。这一点非常清楚。”
然而，这类因素很难预测，特别是因为可驾驶性无法被模拟工具完全捕捉，克拉克也承认了这一点。
“有些情况在模拟中确实无法得到如此清晰的画面，”他说，“例如，这会让你付出多大代价？如果你遇到延迟，或者像折原提到的MGU-K停止工作，以及它如何影响驾驶性。这超出了简单的灵敏度模拟范畴。”
迈克·克拉克，阿斯顿·马丁首席赛道官
除了了解确切原因和本田已采取的措施外，克拉克强调，车队还从新加坡的挫折中吸取了心理层面的教训。
“我认为，在这样的事件之后重新集结很重要，要试着理解为什么会发生，我们在哪些方面吃了亏，然后从中吸取正确的教训，”他说。
“而且（同样重要的是）要稍微更好地管理我们的预期，或者至少在管理预期时，要考虑到可能影响预期的一系列风险，而我们在新加坡没有这样做。”
detailEn: The unexpected problem Honda encountered despite its second F1 power unit upgrade
Even after using its second ADUO upgrade in Madrid, the Japanese manufacturer is still struggling with turbo lag. As a result, driveability on energy-rich circuits proved to be below expectations
Following a surprisingly successful Formula 1 weekend in Malaysia, expectations were also high at Aston Martin for Singapore, a venue that should have suited the AMR26 on paper.

However, the competitive picture at the Marina Bay Street Circuit proved rather disappointing, with Fernando Alonso pointing to problems with the Honda power unit after the race, particularly in terms of driveability.

Honda subsequently sent both its engineers and power units back to Sakura for more in-depth investigations. Those checks did not reveal any specific hardware fault. Instead, it emerged that the Japanese manufacturer was primarily struggling with turbo lag – the time it takes for the turbo to spool up, and therefore the delay between pressing the accelerator and feeling the effect of the turbo kicking in.

That is not a new problem in itself. In fact, it was one of the factors that hampered driveability with the new power unit specification introduced at Zandvoort. But it was precisely for that reason that Honda used its second ADUO token of the year in Madrid to introduce a new turbocharger intended to eliminate the problem.
However, when asked by Motorsport.com, Honda's chief trackside engineer Shintaro Orihara revealed that it had unexpectedly become an issue again in Singapore.

“Even though we introduced a new turbocharger to manage turbo lag, we still struggled to manage that lag in Singapore because of the unique track layout and also the energy-rich situation. That has given some unstable acceleration to the driver,” Orihara admitted.
Shintaro Orihara, Honda Racing Corporation Trackside General Manager and Chief Engineer

Asked whether the turbo lag could be partly compensated for by deploying the MGU-K in different places than usual, Orihara explained that this only works to a certain extent, although he stressed that the MGU-K had contributed to the problem in a different way.

“MGU-K deployment can help [against] turbo lag, but not enough to compensate for it,” he said. “If we go to energy-rich tracks, we normally use the MGU-K harvesting to compensate for turbo lag. If we have enough MGU-K harvesting power, then the engine can run at a high operation point in the off-throttle sections.

“That helps turbo lag and is nice, but if we go to energy-rich circuits, sometimes it's difficult to get enough MGU-K harvesting value because of the energy-rich situation. In that case, the operation mode of the engine is not enough to control turbo lag and that's why we struggled at Singapore.”

The fact that Honda found no specific problems during its checks at the Sakura facility could potentially raise concerns. After all, it suggests that the same issue could arise again when Aston Martin returns to an energy-rich circuit.
However, Honda stressed that lessons have been learned, leading to new measures – not in terms of hardware, but rather in how Honda operates the power unit through software and settings.

“Yes, we have learned some things from Singapore, so we are preparing countermeasures for the future,” said Orihara. “We understand that we need to improve our control of the turbo lag. At the moment, our control is not meeting the driver demands, so we apply some countermeasures. But again, we need to check how those work on our power unit.”
The mental lesson Aston Martin learned in Singapore

As for Singapore, Aston Martin's chief trackside officer Mike Krack said the disappointment was compounded by expectations being too high heading into the race weekend. That, too, is something Aston Martin has learned from and will seek to avoid repeating in Austin.

“I always call them the emotional dynamics,” Krack said when asked about the disappointment by Motorsport.com. “I think Sepang probably surprised us in terms of outcome and it raised the expectation level [for Singapore] maybe even beyond what was realistic.
“And when you do not deliver it for various reasons, then everybody becomes disappointed and it gets more difficult over the weekend. That is very clear.”
However, such factors are difficult to predict, particularly because driveability cannot be fully captured by simulation tools, as Krack also acknowledged.

“It is something that in simulations you cannot really have this clear picture,” he said. “How much will this cost you, for example? If you have lag or what Orihara was mentioning about the MGU-K stopping, and how it affects the drivability. This goes beyond simple sensitivity simulations.”
Mike Krack, Aston Martin Chief Trackside Officer
Aside from understanding the exact cause and the measures Honda has taken, Krack stressed that the team has also learned a mental lesson from the setback in Singapore.
“I think it is important to regroup after such an event and try to understand why it happened, in which areas did we lose out and then take the right learning from it,” he said.

“And [it’s also important] to manage our expectations a little bit better, or at least when you manage expectations, that you have a set of risks that could affect it, which we didn't do in Singapore.”

items.titleZh: APEX创始人：其他运动不应盲目模仿F1
items.summaryZh: APEX创始人兼首席执行官安东尼奥·卡科里诺在一场活动上提出，其他运动可能过于专注追随F1的脚步，而忽视了发挥自身优势。

media.altZh: APEX创始人：其他运动不应盲目模仿F1 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Sports must ditch 'obsession' over F1's success
items.summaryEn: Antonio Cacorino, CEO and founder of APEX, suggested at an event that other sports may be too focused on following in Formula 1's footsteps rather than playing to their own strengths.
detailZh: F1的成功引发了一波追随者，其他运动试图复制F1在所有者自由媒体集团旗下所享有的那种人气飙升。
但这些运动是否过于专注追随F1的脚步，而忽视了发挥自身优势？
这正是APEX创始人兼首席执行官安东尼奥·卡科里诺在《F1高端玩法手册》活动上向达伦·考克斯和观众提出的假设；该活动由The Race与Axios主办。
APEX是一家专注体育的投资公司，获得包括F1车手兰多·诺里斯、卡洛斯·塞恩斯和瓦尔特利·博塔斯在内的100多名运动员支持。该公司还持有阿尔派 F1车队的少数股份。
卡科里诺表示，F1的增长归功于“多种不同因素共同作用的结果”，其中包括经常被提及的Netflix真人秀《极速求生》带来的效应。
“时机也相当重要，”他补充道。“人们没有意识到，Netflix恰好在全世界因新冠疫情停摆、所有人都被困在家中的时候（2020年初）推出了《极速求生》第二季。这也起到了助推作用。
“但在生活中，有时你也需要某些事情恰好契合。他们明白那对他们有利。然后显然，结果就摆在这里。”
自2019年首播以来，《极速求生》催生了一股纪录片热潮，高尔夫PGA巡回赛（《全力挥杆》）、职业网球（《破发点》）、公路自行车（《环法自行车赛：逆风飞驰》）和纳斯卡（《全速前进》）等纷纷效仿。然而，这些系列节目在向新观众展示这些运动方面有多成功，一直难以评判。
“我们已经看到Netflix推出的体育内容数量。显然，我们正处于内容过多的阶段，”卡科里诺说。
“所以，很难取得同样的成功。显然，F1凭借《Drive to Survive》做到了。但我确实认为，这类内容和这种媒体运作是许多大型体育项目需要做的。
“但只有在你达到一定地位之后才行。其他体育项目或许应该有这类策略，但也许可以作为一种吸引更多眼球的方式，然后通过赞助或其他替代方式变现。
“我不认为这应该成为一种执念，因为很难复制。现在有成千上万的体育项目在尝试这样做。”
F1在全球疫情期间及之后的增长，得益于其作为当时首批恢复比赛的体育项目之一的独特地位、《极速求生》效应，以及2021年刘易斯·汉密尔顿与马克斯·维斯塔潘之间的冠军争夺战，这些因素共同帮助它成为如今这样的庞然大物。
当在台上被问及他是否看到F1未来面临任何风险时，卡科里诺表示：“说实话，我看不到太多风险。我认为它规模太大，不会失败。”
“它确实已经达到了一个让车迷留下来的水平。我不认为有任何其他运动能挑战它。”
“显然，你可能会遇到监管规则变化，新的潜在所有者可能进来，或许会把它引向不同的方向。但我确实认为F1已经达到了一个会持续存在的位置。它是这个全球知识产权，品牌会想要进来。”
“车迷们始终会在这里关注并消费这项运动。总会有越来越多不同的车手和明星涌现出来。
“所以我认为风险很小，只是任何其他行业都会面临的普遍宏观（经济）风险。
“但我要说，不存在任何结构性风险。因此我抱有长期愿景，我今天就会投资，并长期作为投资者留下来。”
detailEn: Formula 1’s success has triggered a wave of aspirants as other sports try to match the same meteoric rise in popularity that F1 has enjoyed under owner Liberty Media.
But are those other sports too focused on following F1’s footsteps over playing to their own strengths?
That’s the hypothesis that Antonio Cacorino, CEO and founder of APEX, offered to Darren Cox and the audience at 'Formula One's Premium Playbook', an event hosted by The Race and Axios.
APEX is a sports-focused investment firm backed by more than 100 athletes including F1’s Lando Norris, Carlos Sainz, and Valtteri Bottas. It also owns a minority stake in the Alpine F1 team.
Cacorino said that F1’s growth is down to a “combination of different factors that all clicked together”, including the regularly cited effect of Netflix’s Drive to Survive reality series.

“Timings were also quite important," he added. "People don't realise the fact that Drive to Survive Season 2 was being pushed by Netflix exactly when the whole world stopped and everyone was stuck at home in COVID [in early 2020]. That also helped.
“But in life, sometimes you also need certain things to click. And they understood that was in their favour. And then obviously the result is here.”

Drive to Survive spawned a documentary race since it premiered in 2019, with the likes of golf's PGA Tour (Full Swing), professional tennis (Break Point), road cycling (Tour de France: Unchained) and NASCAR (Full Speed) following suit. Yet how successful those series were at exposing those sports to new audiences has been hard to judge.
“We already see the amount of sports content that Netflix is putting out. Obviously, we're at the stage where there's too much content,” said Cacorino.

“So, it's very hard to achieve the same success. Obviously, F1 did with Drive to Survive. But I do think it's that kind of content and that kind of media play is something that a lot of the big sports need to do.

“But only once you've achieved certain status. Other sports should maybe have those kinds of strategies, but maybe kind of as a way to bring a bit more eyeballs and then monetise through sponsorships or through other alternatives.
"I don't think that should be an obsession, because it's very hard to replicate. Now there's thousands of sports trying to do it.”

F1’s growth during and after the global pandemic, thanks to its unique position as one of the first sports to return to competition during that time, the Drive to Survive effect, and the 2021 championship fight between Lewis Hamilton and Max Verstappen, helped it become the juggernaut it is now.
Asked on stage if he sees any risks on the horizon for F1, Cacorino said: “To be honest, I don't see many risks. I think it's too big to fail.
“It's reached, really, a level where fans are here to stay. I don't think there's any other sport challenging.

“Obviously you can get regulatory changes, a new potential owner can come in and maybe take it in a different direction. But I do think that F1 has reached a position where it's here to stay. It's this global IP that brands will want to come in.
“Fans are always going to be here consuming the sport. There's always going to be more and more different drivers and stars coming up.
“So I think there's few risks, just general macro[economic] risks that any other sector can take.
“But I would say there's nothing structural that would call for a risk. Hence the long-term vision I have that I would invest today and stay as an investor for a long time.”
keyPointsZh: APEX是一家体育领域投资公司，背后有包括诺里斯、塞恩斯和博塔斯在内的100多名运动员支持。
APEX还持有阿尔派 F1车队的少数股份。
keyPointsEn: APEX is a sports-focused investment firm backed by more than 100 athletes, including Lando Norris, Carlos Sainz and Valtteri Bottas.
APEX also owns a minority stake in the Alpine F1 team.

items.titleZh: 小红牛在奥斯汀站后确定两个关键关注点
items.summaryZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在奥斯汀站的练习赛中表现出色，但车队仍需关注两个关键领域。

media.altZh: 小红牛在奥斯汀站后确定两个关键关注点 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Red Bull identifies two "key focus" areas after Max Verstappen's promising start in Austin
detailZh: 小红牛在马克斯·维斯塔潘在奥斯汀站的练习赛中表现出色后确定两个关键关注点。
维斯塔潘认为在美洲赛道的第一天“一点也不糟糕”。除了极端的颠簸外，技术总监皮埃尔·瓦切还指出了另一个对小红牛来说非常重要的领域。
马克斯·维斯塔潘在奥斯汀站的练习赛中排名第二和第三。在两场练习赛中，这位四次世界冠军都落后查尔斯·勒克莱尔不到两十分，后者在两场练习赛中都设定了基准。
例如，小红牛并没有像在马来西亚那样立即从其他车队中脱颖而出，但维斯塔潘仍然对小红牛22在德克萨斯州的早期表现表示满意。
“本周末的起步很积极。这条赛道在寻找高速和低速弯角之间的最佳妥协点时从来都不容易”，荷兰人在FP2结束后说道。
“这些凹凸使得情况更加困难，因此你需要在车内找到良好的平衡并进入节奏。这就是我们在FP1和FP2之间一直在努力的事情。为了微调这个平衡，我们还有更多的工作要做，但总的来说，这并不是一个糟糕的一天。”
从实际意义上讲，这意味着车队本周末需要在两种不同的方式中找到妥协。鉴于美国赛车场的布局多样化，第一个问题关注的是高速和低速弯角之间的平衡。根据GPS数据，红牛在高速路段表现出竞争力，这使得技术总监皮埃尔·瓦赫非常明确地知道需要改进的地方。
“目前我们关注的显然是低速性能。低速对我们来说至关重要。”
这反映在数据中。比较勒克莱尔、安东内利和维斯塔潘的最快圈速，赛道的最慢弯道几乎都是红色的——换句话说，这是法拉利的领地。勒克莱尔在刹车和1号弯的出弯处都很强，在11号弯，也就是长直道前的慢速左弯，也表现出同样的模式。
在那个长直道的末端——就在刹车点之前——维斯塔潘几乎比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，而安东内利则快了超过两十分之一。然而，维斯塔潘在12号到16号弯之间损失了大量的时间，这是赛道上的另一个较慢的段落。
这强调了瓦赫的评论，尽管在奥斯汀的挑战不仅仅是找到不同类型弯道的正确平衡。同样重要的是在绝对性能和能够合理应对颠簸的赛车之间的妥协，维斯塔潘在周四的媒体日将其描述为“无法接受”和“失控”。
当被问及小红牛22如何应对赛道条件时，瓦赫说：“赛车对那些颠簸的反应就像你预期的那样，它跳得很多。”
“赛道非常颠簸，尤其是在1号弯道刹车时。你必须非常小心。但是，是的，这就是我们使用这种设置的问题所在。它没有去年那么硬，但也没有那么远[偏离那个程度]。这辆车的颠簸适应性在这里不是很好。”
使用“设置”这个术语，Wache并不是指红牛的选择，而是指当前一代的F1赛车。理论上，这些赛车在颠簸路面上应该比近年来的地面效应赛车更舒适，但维斯塔潘在周四解释说，实际情况正好相反。
得益于主动空气动力学和直线模式，赛车在直道上略微上升。这限制了滑块磨损，使车队能够在车身高度方面进一步突破极限。因此，在刹车和过弯时，车身高度保持较低，这正是美洲赛道极其颠簸的区域。
据Wache所说，改善赛车在那些颠簸上的表现和其低速性能是红牛在排位赛前的两个主要优先事项。
detailEn: Red Bull identifies two "key focus" areas after Max Verstappen's promising start in Austin

Verstappen concludes that Friday at the Circuit of the Americas was "not a bad day at all". Alongside the extreme bumps, technical director Pierre Waché pinpoints another important area for Red Bull to focus on

Max Verstappen finished Friday's practice sessions for the Formula 1 United States Grand Prix in second and third place. In both sessions, the four-time world champion was less than two tenths behind Charles Leclerc, who set the benchmark on both occasions.
Red Bull is not immediately standing out from the rest of the field as it did in Malaysia, for example, but Verstappen is nevertheless largely satisfied with the early signs from the RB22 in Texas.
"It's been a positive start to the weekend. This track is never easy when it comes to finding the right compromise between the low and high-speed corners", the Dutchman said after FP2.

"The bumps make it even more difficult, so you’re trying to find a good balance in the car and get into a rhythm. That’s what we’ve been working on between FP1 and FP2. There’s still a bit more work to do to fine-tune that balance, but it wasn’t a bad day at all."

In practical terms, this means teams have to find a compromise in two different ways this weekend. Given the varied layout of the Circuit of the Americas, the first concerns the balance between high-speed and low-speed corners. Based on the GPS data, Red Bull appears competitive in the high-speed sections, making technical director Pierre Wache very clear about what needs to improve.
"It's clearly the low speed performance that we are focused on at the moment. Low speed is the key for us."

That is reflected in the data. Comparing the fastest laps of Leclerc, Antonelli and Verstappen, the slowest corners on the circuit are predominantly coloured red – in other words, Ferrari territory. Leclerc is strong both on the brakes and on the exit of Turn 1, and shows the same pattern at Turn 11, the slow left-hander before the long straight.

At the end of that long straight – just before the braking point – Verstappen is almost a tenth ahead of Leclerc's time, while Antonelli is more than two tenths ahead. However, Verstappen loses considerable ground through Turns 12 to 16, another slower section of the circuit.

This underlines Wache's comments, although the challenge in Austin is not just about finding the right balance between different types of corners. Equally important is the compromise between outright performance and a car that can cope reasonably well with the bumps, which Verstappen described as "unacceptable" and "out of control" during Thursday's media day.
"The car reacts to those bumps how you would expect, it's jumping a lot", Wache said when asked how the RB22 is dealing with the track conditions.

"The track is massively bumpy, especially at Turn 1 under braking. You have to be very careful. But yeah, that’s the problem with this type of set-up that we are using. It is not as stiff as last year, but also not so far [away from that]. The car is not very compliant on the bumps here."

By using the term set-up, Wache is not referring specifically to Red Bull's choices, but to the current generation of F1 cars. In theory, these should be slightly more comfortable over the bumps than the ground-effect cars of recent years, but Verstappen explained on Thursday that the opposite is actually the case.

Thanks to active aerodynamics and straight mode, the cars rise slightly on the straights. This limits wear on the skid blocks and gives teams the freedom to push the limits even further in terms of ride height. As a result, the ride height is low under braking and through the corners, precisely the areas where the Circuit of the Americas is extremely bumpy.
According to Wache, improving the car's behaviour over those bumps and its low-speed performance are Red Bull's two main priorities ahead of qualifying.
keyPointsZh: 车队技术总监皮埃尔·瓦切指出，除了极端的颠簸外，还有另一个重要领域需要关注
尽管小红牛没有像在马来西亚那样立即脱颖而出，但维斯塔潘对小红牛22在德克萨斯州的早期表现表示满意
keyPointsEn: Technical director Pierre Waché identifies another important area to focus on
Verstappen is largely satisfied with the early signs from the RB22 in Texas
